news.title: Econframe Swings to FY2026 Net Loss of RM2.58 Million on RM10.07 Million LYASB Goodwill Impairment Despite 35% Revenue Growth

recent_en: EFRAME posted a net loss of RM2.58 million for the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, mainly due to a RM10.07 million goodwill impairment on LYASB, despite 35% revenue growth. The company issued an 'Others' announcement on 1 Oct 2026.
notable_en: Recorded a net loss of RM2.58 million for the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026, including a RM10.07 million goodwill impairment on LYASB.
Revenue for the quarter grew 35% year-on-year.
risks_en: The quarter swung to a net loss, mainly due to a RM10.07 million goodwill impairment on LYASB.
